description: Blazor project and item templates with Telerik UI for Blazor and Docker integration. Configure the Telerik Blazor components via template options like CSS theme, icon type, localization, and RTL support.
releaseNotes:
NEW
* Added support for the latest .NET 10 Preview. Always use preview .NET versions with the latest Telerik UI for Blazor version.
* Added support for Telerik UI for Blazor 10.0.0.

FIXED
* Refactored the Telerik UI for Blazor version retrieval in App.razor for cache busting purposes.
* Do not load package Microsoft.Extensions.Localization in the server project of Blazor Web Apps.
* Do not import the Microsoft.Extensions.Localization namespace in Program.cs, as IStringLocalizer is not used.
* Target .NET 8 by default, instead of .NET 9, until .NET 10 becomes official.
title: Telerik Blazor Project and Item Templates
